metadata.title: From Nothing to Fold: A Premise-Free, Parameter-Free and Machine-Closed Foundation for Smithian Fold Theory
metadata.description:
Foundation Branch Paper 002 is the exhaustive V3 successor account of the Smithian Fold Theory Foundation. It reviews all 356 V1 entries and all 407 V2 entries, decomposes the 24 Foundation-relevant source entries into 32 atomic Foundation obligations, and closes all 32 at their registered exact strength.

Sixteen model-admitted theorems are documented through 5,222 generated candidate classes, 64 adverse-control executions and 16 implementation-distinct reproductions. The chain runs from the premise-free operational root through structural One, exact positive count and part coordinates, the minimal Fold, exact operations, half-One, two-preimage Fold dynamics, mechanically scoped primitive-map uniqueness, recursive form closure, replayable proof traces, one-way measurement custody and the unique fail-closed admission route.

The paper contains the complete dependency, grammar, cardinality, elimination, survivor, minimality, closure, control, certificate and receipt account for every theorem. It imports no numerical zero, signed quantity, floating-point proof value, irrational or imaginary proof value, fitted parameter, axiom or measurement-selected law. Because Foundation derives no physical quantity, its applicable external check is implementation-distinct formal reproduction; the paper separately forces the custody law that later empirical branches must use for pre-seal prediction and post-seal authoritative comparison.

The deposited PDF is the primary landing-page paper. The Markdown source and machine-readable evidence files are supplied with it. Foundation Paper 001 remains an immutable earlier version; Paper 002 does not rewrite that record.
